tasks.name: 创建笔记数据库模型
实现笔记的 CRUD API
创建笔记管理前端页面
实现前端与后端的 API 集成
测试笔记功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database schema with fields like title, content, timestamp, and user ID; use an ORM like SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for efficient querying and consider scalability.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations using a framework like Flask or Django REST Framework.
T2.notes: Implement authentication and validation for secure and accurate data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end page using a framework like React or Vue.js with components for listing, creating, editing, and deleting notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and ensure compatibility across devices.

T4.implementation_approach: Use Axios or Fetch API to connect the front-end with the back-end API, handling requests and responses for CRUD operations.
T4.notes: Implement error handling and loading states for better user experience.

T5.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for both front-end and back-end using tools like Jest, Mocha, or Postman to ensure functionality and reliability.
T5.notes: Test edge cases and simulate real-world scenarios to validate robustness.
